summary: Resolved with high confidence. Carlo Khatchi is the founder/principal and president-level owner of a small, privately held Oakland residential construction and structural-repair company serving the Greater Bay Area. Public sources conflict on employee and revenue estimates, so broad ranges are used.

resolution.ambiguity_note: Multiple public LinkedIn profiles exist for Carlo Khatchi, but the Oakland location and matching company identify the contact confidently.

evidence.claim: Company website identifies Carlo Khatchi as founder and principal.
